result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and written deletion certification. However, it goes beyond the playbook by covering all Works and Confidential Information. More importantly, termination of any single Statement of Work triggers return and deletion of all Company data and Confidential Information, potentially disrupting other active Statements of Work. The trigger and data scope should be limited to the terminated arrangement or data no longer needed for ongoing services.
